_doc: Tani — one of the two exceptional shop leaders who anchor the technician pit in Act 6. Competent, fair, and fiercely protective of her crew. Altered from Tanya. She and Cap'n H represent the rarest thing the machine accidentally produces: genuinely good leaders operating in a pocket the machine forgot to surveil. Dialogue-only.
name: Tani
title: Shop Team Lead
samplePhrase: Nobody touches my crew without going through me first. That includes whatever that is coming down from the office.
